text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I guess it's about time.
...I'm heading out, Trainer.
choice_data_list: If it's you today, I know you can run a great race
The you of today can run a great race!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Standing before the mirror and neatening her appearance before the race.
It was proof of the quiet fire burning within her.
choice_data_list: I've been like that since I was little.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"A little room to breathe, and a fiery passion burning deep within.
...I don't feel like I'd lose to anyone."

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"So, watch closely.
I'm gonna engrave my run... into everyone's hearts!"
